title: Update replay vision alert
description: Partially update a replay vision alert. Send only the fields to change. `scanner_id` and `kind` are fixed after creation. Set `enabled: false` to pause it (a metric alert resets to `not_firing`), or set `snooze_until` to an ISO 8601 timestamp to silence it until then and to null to unsnooze. To manage where it notifies, use `vision-alerts-destinations-create` and `vision-alerts-destinations-delete`.
